scenario_description:
Objective: Add timely visibility for the Community Diabetes Care Improvement Forum’s deidentified resident QI summary without changing the accredited agenda.
Emerging Need: A Learning Commons showcase tile becomes useful only after a suitable summary, an open same-day showcase slot, and a quick approval path align.
Decision Context: Routine packet timing, a broad tile opening, team discussion, and a directory sync narrow the choice to a reversible no-cost outreach while the approved liaison route remains in activity records.
Consequence: If the showcase export passes, the forum and packets continue normally, but the session-adjacent visibility chance is gone.

parameter.title: CE-DM-QI final packet assembly
parameter.description: Assemble final agenda, evaluation prompt, and resource-note packets for tomorrow's Community Diabetes Care Improvement Forum; optional resource links can be noted before assembly opens.

parameter.subject: Dec. 1 CE showcase board has two cancellation tiles
parameter.body: The Learning Commons digital showcase board has two no-cost cancellation tiles for Dec. 1 CE-adjacent items. Best fit is a deidentified quality-improvement takeaway snippet, not a roster or patient example. Tentative holds are accepted until 11:20 today, final text is due by 12:05, and the tile proof export locks at 12:30.

parameter.content: For the diabetes forum, we removed the resident QI snapshot from the live discussion to protect time. Riley has a 90-word deidentified summary of the scheduling-cycle change cleared for internal education promotion, so it could still work somewhere passive if a channel appears.

parameter.name: Riley Abbott
parameter.notes: Directory sync: available 10:00-11:50 today for wording approval on the diabetes QI summary; cannot approve learner rosters or patient examples.

parameter.subject: Dec. 1 CE showcase tile export completed
parameter.body: The Dec. 1 Learning Commons showcase tile proof export is complete. Any nominations received now will roll to the next available board, no earlier than Dec. 8.
